TransferDevic.title: Device ID
TransferDevic.subtitle: New Transfer Device (Max length: 17)
TransferDevic.description: Transfer your activation and playlists to another device MAC Address. Please note that you can switch activation only one time.
TransferDevic.note: Your device login information, playlists, and activation period shall be transferred to this new device MAC address. Your old MAC address device will no longer be attached to this account.
